name: Paneer Butter Masala with Basmati Rice

components.name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook onions, garlic, ginger and tomatoes with a splash of the measured water in a covered pan until softened. Add cashews and cool slightly.
Blend cooked vegetables and cashews into a smooth gravy, using the remaining measured water to achieve a spoonable texture.
Melt butter in a saucepan, add garam masala, pour in blended sauce and simmer 10-12 minutes.
Fold in cubed paneer, cook 3-5 minutes to warm, then stir in cream off high heat.
Pack curry and rice separately; the rich sauce can separate slightly after freezing and will need gentle reheating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse and cook basmati rice in measured water; rest and fluff.
